div.p:
THE APPLICATION, NOT THE CACHE, OWNS THE READ PATH: CHECK THE
CACHE, AND ON A MISS READ THE DATABASE AND POPULATE THE CACHE
BEFORE RETURNING. THE CACHE IS NEVER IN THE WRITE PATH, SO IT CAN
FAIL WITHOUT TAKING THE SYSTEM DOWN.

ul.li:
SD-NOTES/TOOLS/APPLICATION_CACHING.D2 — THE CACHE_CHECK
BRANCH WITH HIT AND MISS PATHS, PLUS TTL AND INVALIDATION, IS THE
CACHE-ASIDE READ PATH.
